selected.title: Evervault launches Browser Tokens, enabling secure agentic payments
selected.summary: Evervault today announced the launch of Browser Tokens at Money20/20, giving developers building agentic commerce products a secure way for AI agents and browser automations to make purchases, log in to accounts and complete sensitive online workflows without exposing payment cards, passwords or personal data to the agent or browser provider.
selected.why: New product launch enabling AI agent autonomous payment workflows.

reason: AI agents handling autonomous payments without human oversight raises genuine regulatory and consumer protection questions that merit reasoned debate.
angle: Enabling AI agents to execute payments autonomously prioritizes developer convenience over the financial system's need for human decision-making checkpoints in high-stakes transactions.
